text:
maria: heads-up — we're seeing provisional credits spike on streaming reconnects for churny mobile clients. Dashboard shows confirmed=0 but provisional jumped 7k tokens. Anyone else?

aj: saw similar in customer X last night, looks like resume path double-counts prefix on reconnect

kevin: is this the same as the suffix-trim issue or a different path? link to trace: https://internal/traces/3654321987

sophia: different. I dug into router logs, sample: ```RETRY session=abc resume=true prefix_tokens=128 credited=128``` then ```CONFIRM session=abc commit=0 credited=0```. We never subtract provisional on confirm if commit=0

maria: oh that explains it — provisional left orphaned. Are we leaking provisional pool? :grimacing:

dave: can we repro with unit test? thinking small harness that simulates reconnect + server-side early EOF

aj: yes — with short heartbeats it repros in ~10s. I'll attach logs

ops-bot: deployment 2026-03-18T03:12:45Z completed on canary

kevin: telemetry sampling makes this worse; we sample 1% of sessions so console graphs don't always capture it. We need session-level tags in metrics

sophia: proposal: add session_id to provisional counter and emit confirm event that decrements provisional if commit=0. Also emit metric "provisional_orphaned" when confirm=0

maria: sounds good. UX question: console should show provisional vs confirmed per-model, per-route. Right now provisional is global

aj: +1. Also quota enforcement still counts provisional immediately which is surprising to customers

dave: alternative: don't charge quota for provisional until confirm OR mark provisional as 'soft charge' that doesn't decrement quota but shows up in provisional column

kevin: can't change enforcement quickly; we'd break rate-limits. Maybe soften in UI only and run nightly reconciliation that refunds customers if discrepancy > threshold

sophia: reconciliation is needed anyway. But we should fix root cause first: the confirm path ignores `commit` flag when resume telemetry flows through the fallback router

maria: who's picking up the router fix? aj or kevin?

aj: I can take the router fix (small). I'll also add session-id tagging in metrics. Plan: router patch -> add metric labels (session_id, route) -> unit tests + canary

dave: timeline?

aj: PR by EOD, canary tomorrow morning. Reconcile job change next sprint

kevin: I'll wire console to surface provisional_orphaned alerts and add a dashboard row with a reconciliation status

sophia: small snippet for metric emit (pseudo):
```
emit_metric("provisional_tokens", {session: sid, model: m}, tokens)
on_confirm: emit_metric("confirm_tokens", {session: sid, model: m}, tokens)
if confirm==0: emit_metric("provisional_orphaned", {session: sid}, tokens)
```

maria: perfect. Also add an alert threshold: provisional_orphaned_rate > 0.5% for 10m

aj: noted. I'll include in PR

ops-bot: alert created: PROV_ORPHAN_RATE threshold 0.5% 10m

kevin: thanks. we'll follow up in eng-platform sync tomorrow to lock QA criteria

maria: TY all. If anyone sees customer-facing billing hits, ping #support and tag me
